task_completion.description: Create a tiddler titled 'Medication Explorer' with the tag 'Dashboard'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler open in the TiddlyWiki interface with the title 'Medication Explorer' and the tag 'Dashboard' visible in the tag area.

task_completion.description: Implement a two-column layout for the dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Medication Explorer' tiddler displays content split into two distinct side-by-side panes or columns.

task_completion.description: The left pane lists all tiddlers tagged 'Medication'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The left column of the dashboard contains a list of medication names (e.g., names of drugs).

task_completion.description: Display 'Please select a medication.' when no medication is selected.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The right pane explicitly shows the text 'Please select a medication.' when the dashboard is first opened or no list item is clicked.

task_completion.description: Selecting a medication updates the state tiddler '$:/state/selected-med'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Clicking a medication in the left list causes the right pane to change content, or the agent is seen configuring the action to target '$:/state/selected-med'.

task_completion.description: The detail pane shows the title, Class, Indications, Side Effects, and body text.
task_completion.visual_evidence: When a medication is selected, the right pane displays: the medication name as a heading, the labels 'Class:', 'Indications:', and 'Side Effects:' followed by data, and the descriptive body text.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and edit the tiddler.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent typing into the TiddlyWiki edit fields and clicking 'save' (tick icon), rather than just using terminal commands to overwrite files.

integrity.description: The agent used TiddlyWiki syntax (filters/transclusions) rather than hardcoding a static list of medications.
integrity.visual_evidence: The edit mode of the tiddler shows code like '[tag[Medication]]' or '{{!!drug-class}}' instead of a manually typed list of 15 drugs.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the resulting dashboard to verify it works.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor clicking a medication in the list and the right pane successfully updating in response.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dashboard must be titled 'Medication Explorer' and tagged 'Dashboard'. The specific empty state string required is 'Please select a medication.' The state tiddler used for selection must be '$:/state/selected-med'. The detail fields to display are 'drug-class', 'indications', and 'common-side-effects' using the specific labels 'Class:', 'Indications:', and 'Side Effects:'.
